subject.title: [Feature] Configurable thinking/reasoning block format per channel

question: Should visible reasoning formatting be a portable agent-level contract with channel capability fallbacks, or a Telegram-only channel setting with no cross-channel promise?
rationale: This choice defines the public configuration surface, precedence, supported style vocabulary, and compatibility behavior; it cannot be safely inferred from the closed incomplete PR or from the issue’s examples.

options.title: Portable contract with channel fallbacks
options.body: Define a small agent-level presentation enum, preserve italic by default, and document deterministic rendering or fallback for channels that cannot represent a selected style.

options.title: Telegram-only setting
options.body: Keep the behavior inside the Telegram plugin and limit supported values to Telegram’s documented formatting capabilities.

options.title: Decline new configuration
options.body: Retain the existing portable italic presentation and consider a future general channel-rendering policy instead of a dedicated reasoning setting.

recommendation.title: Portable contract with channel fallbacks
recommendation.body: Define a small agent-level presentation enum, preserve italic by default, and document deterministic rendering or fallback for channels that cannot represent a selected style.

likelyOwner.reason: The shared embedded-agent reasoning projection is the central owner boundary, and recent history plus the existing review place this person closest to that contract.
